Definition: What proportion of businesses does the register cover?
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: No authoritative source publishes a specific proportion of businesses covered by the digital tax register. SRC confirms mandatory business/VAT registration (28 days of trading; VAT threshold SCR 2m) and OECD Revenue Statistics in Africa 2025 shows a high tax-to-GDP ratio (29.1% in 2023, highest in Africa), consistent with a well-formalised base, but this is indirect evidence, not a coverage percentage. Seychelles' 2019 TADAT assessment (which would normally quantify registered vs. estimated taxpayer base) has no published Performance Assessment Report. The original "70-89%" score was an unsourced assumption per the Comments field and cannot be confirmed against the Format scale; recalculated to 0 (Unknown) — recommend human review if a business-register/TIN coverage statistic can be sourced directly from SRC or IMF technical assistance reports.
